title: Frequently Asked Questions
subtitle: Everything you need to know about shopping with ShopWave.
contactBody: Our support team is available 24/7 and will get back to you within a few hours.
emptyDescription: We haven't published any frequently asked questions yet. Check back soon, or contact us and we'll be happy to help.

items.question: How do I place an order?
items.answer: Browse the catalog, add items to your cart, and proceed to checkout. You'll receive an order confirmation by email immediately after payment.

items.question: What payment methods are accepted?
items.answer: We accept all major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex), PayPal, and Apple Pay. All transactions are encrypted with 256-bit TLS.

items.question: How long does shipping take?
items.answer: Standard shipping takes 3–5 business days. Express shipping (1–2 business days) is available at checkout. Free standard shipping on orders over $50.

items.question: Can I return or exchange an item?
items.answer: Yes. We offer a 30-day hassle-free return policy. Items must be in their original condition and packaging. Initiate a return from your account dashboard.

items.question: How do I track my order?
items.answer: Once your order ships, you'll receive a tracking number by email. You can also check the status in the Orders section of your account.

items.question: Is my personal information secure?
items.answer: Absolutely. We never sell your data. All personal information is stored securely and only used to process your orders and improve your experience.

items.question: Do you ship internationally?
items.answer: Currently we ship to over 30 countries. At checkout, enter your country to see available shipping options and estimated delivery times.

items.question: How do I contact customer support?
items.answer: You can reach us via live chat (bottom-right of any page), by email at support@shopwave.com, or through the Contact page. We respond within a few hours.
